items.raw_excerpt: The State Government has received over 25,000 grievance redressal petitions in the Praja Seva Abhiyan, which was launched by Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar on Saturday at Kudligi in Vijayanagar district.
items.summary_en: Over 25,000 citizens submitted grievance petitions during the Praja Seva Abhiyan program in Karnataka. The initiative was launched by Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar in Kudligi town. The program aims to address people's complaints and concerns directly.
items.summary_ko: 카르나타카 주의 프라자 세바 아비얀 프로그램에 시민 25,000명 이상이 민원을 접수했습니다. 디케 시바쿠마르 주지사가 쿠드리기 마을에서 이 사업을 시작했습니다. 이 프로그램은 주민들의 불만과 문제를 직접 해결하는 것을 목표로 합니다.
items.title_en: 25,000 petitions received in Karnataka government grievance program

items.raw_excerpt: El múltiple campeón mundial de patinaje de velocidad y la capitana de "Las Diablas" liderarán a la delegación nacional en la cita continental en Santa Fe.
items.summary_en: Multiple world speed skating champion Emanuelle Silva and Las Diablas captain Manuela Urroz will lead Chile's delegation at the South American Games in Santa Fe. The two athletes will carry the national flag at the continental sporting event.
items.summary_ko: 다수의 세계 피겨스케이팅 챔피언 에마누엘레 실바와 라스디아블라스 주장 마누엘라 우로스가 산타페 남미게임에서 칠레 대표단을 이끈다. 이 두 선수는 대륙 스포츠 대회에서 국기를 들게 된다.
items.title_en: World Speed Skating Champion and Hockey Captain Named Flag Bearers for South American Games
items.title_ko: 피겨스케이팅 챔피언과 하키 대표팀 주장, 남미게임 칠레 국기 게양자로 선정
items.title_original: Emanuelle Silva y Manuela Urroz serán los abanderados de Chile en los Juegos Suramericanos

items.raw_excerpt: Minister, David Maynier, has lauded the reconstructed chalets and a bridge at the Letaba rest camp
items.summary_en: South African Environment Minister David Maynier praised newly reconstructed chalets and a bridge at Letaba rest camp in Kruger National Park. The facilities were rebuilt as part of ongoing upgrades to improve visitor accommodation. The camp is a popular stop in one of Africa's largest game reserves.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 환경부 데이비드 메이니에르 장관이 크루저 국립공원 레타바 휴게소에 새로 지은 별장과 다리를 높이 평가했다. 해당 시설은 방문객 숙박 시설 개선을 위해 진행된 리모델링 사업의 일환이다. 레타바 휴게소는 아프리카 최대 규모 국립공원 내 인기 있는 숙박 명소다.
items.title_en: South African Minister Praises Rebuilt Chalets and Bridge at Kruger Park Camp
items.title_ko: 남아공 환경부 장관, 크루거공원 레타바 야영장 리모델링 시설 호평
items.title_original: Maynier lauds reconstructed facilities at KNP’s Letaba Rest Camp

items.raw_excerpt: A.P. Tourism Minister clarifies that land for Kapu Bhavan does not belong to Telugu University amid construction plans.
items.summary_en: The Andhra Pradesh Tourism Minister has clarified that the land proposed for Kapu Bhavan construction does not belong to Telugu University. This clarification comes amid ongoing discussions about the construction plans. The minister addressed confusion about the ownership of the land designated for the project.

items.title_en: AP Tourism Minister Clarifies Kapu Bhavan Land Does Not Belong to Telugu University

items.title_original: A.P. Tourism Minister clarifies, land for Kapu Bhavan does not belong to Telugu University

items.raw_excerpt: A slow march of cars travelled along roads leading to the Galp refinery in Sines, in the Setúbal district, to protest the increase in fuel prices.
items.summary_en: Drivers drove cars slowly toward the Galp refinery in Sines to protest the fuel price increase. The slow march took place on roads in the Setubal district.

items.raw_excerpt: They say more than 35 cars have been impounded, including sedans, seven-seaters, and minibus taxis.
items.summary_en: More than 35 cars including sedans, seven-seaters, and minibus taxis were impounded in Mahikeng, South Africa. E-hailing services in the city have been halted as a result. The impounded vehicles included private cars and public transport taxis.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 마킹에서 세단, 7인승 차량, 미니버스 택시 등 차량 35대 이상이 압수됐다. 이로 인해 마킹 지역 에어헤일링 서비스가 전면 중단됐다. 압수된 차량에는 개인 승용차와 대중교통 택시가 포함됐다.
items.title_en: E-Hailing services halted in Mahikeng after cars impounded

items.raw_excerpt: The cost of replacing clamps that are damaged or illegally removed from vehicles on Dublin streets could potentially be almost €800,000 over a three-year period, according to Dublin City Council.
items.summary_en: Dublin City Council says replacing wheel clamps that are damaged or illegally removed could cost almost €800,000 over three years. The clamps are used to immobilize illegally parked vehicles on Dublin streets. The council reported the potential cost as part of its operations review.
items.summary_ko: 더블린 시의회는 도심 노상에서 불법 주차 차량에 부착된 휠 클램프의 손상이나 불법 제거로 인한 교체 비용이 3년간 거의 80만 유로에 달할 수 있다고 밝혔습니다. 시의회는 클램프 교체 비용 증가에 대한 대응 방안을 검토 중입니다.
items.title_en: Damaged, removed clamps may cost €800k over three years
items.title_ko: 손상되거나 불법 제거된 클램프, 3년간 80만 유로 비용 발생
items.title_original: Damaged, removed clamps may cost €800k over three years

items.raw_excerpt: The second season of the popular Hulu series is scheduled to film across Ontario locations through Jan. 2027.
items.summary_en: The second season of the Hulu series The Testaments will film across several Ontario locations. Production is scheduled to continue through January 2027. Caledon Village is among the communities chosen for filming.

items.raw_excerpt: Fascination with South Africa’s rock art heritage has drawn Victor Biggs to more than 2 000 sites over 60 years. Here he discusses the Kei River rock art.
items.summary_en: Victor Biggs has spent 60 years visiting over 2,000 rock art sites across South Africa. He discusses the fascinating rock art found in the Kei River region. His dedication to studying these ancient artworks spans decades of passionate exploration.
items.summary_ko: 빅터 비그스는 60년간 남아프리카공화국 전역의 2,000개가 넘는 바위 예술 유적지를 탐방했습니다. 그는 케이강 지역에서 발견된 흥미로운 바위 예술에 대해 이야기합니다. 그의 고대 예술 작품 연구에 대한 헌신은 수십 년간의 열정적인 탐험으로 이어졌습니다.
items.title_en: Retired farmer explores Kei River's ancient rock art
items.title_ko: 퇴직 농부, 케이강의 고대 바위 예술 탐구

items.raw_excerpt: The Eiffel Tower was closed on Monday afternoon after staff staged a wildcat strike over what they said was a demand that female staff members be excluded during a private visit at the monument over the weekend.
items.summary_en: Workers at the Eiffel Tower went on strike Monday afternoon. They protested a demand that female staff be kept away during a private visit over the weekend. The famous Paris landmark was forced to close.
items.summary_ko: 에펠탑 근로자들이 월요일 오후 돌파업을 벌였다. 이들은 지난 주말 사설 방문 기간 동안 여성 직원들의 출입을 제외하라는 요구에 항의했다. 이로 인해 세계적으로 유명한 파리의 랜드마크가 문을 닫아야 했다.
items.title_en: Eiffel Tower staff strike over demand to exclude women during VIP visit
items.title_ko: 에펠탑 직원들, VIP 방문 시 여성 직원 배제 요구에 항의해 파업

items.raw_excerpt: The 23-year-old ran as high as third at the Italian GP in Monza, but a mistake forced him to fight back, finishing ninth
items.summary_en: Franco Colapinto ran as high as third at the Italian GP in Monza. A mistake forced him to fight back and finish ninth. He was tearful but still earned championship points.

items.summary_en: Pellegrini's Betis will play their first league phase match against Lille in the Champions League. The team led by the Chilean coach faces Davide Ancelotti's side in France.

items.title_original: ¿Cuándo y dónde ver el debut del Betis de Pellegrini ante Lille por la Champions League?

items.raw_excerpt: Idealizada pelo Museu das Mulheres, mostra ocupa salas do segundo andar do CCBB do Rio de Janeiro, após passar por Belém, Fortaleza e Brasília.
items.summary_en: An exhibition organized by the Museum of Women is now on the second floor of CCBB in Rio de Janeiro. The exhibition highlights the powerful art created by women from the Amazon region. It previously traveled to Belém, Fortaleza, and Brasília before coming to Rio.

items.raw_excerpt: En la edición de este lunes 7 de septiembre el panel de Cooperativa Deportes desmeniza la fecha 22 con el empate de Colo Colo y los triunfos de la UC y la U.
items.summary_en: In matchday 22 of the Chilean football season, Colo Colo drew their match while Universidad Católica and Universidad de Chile both won. The draw leaves Colo Colo 11 points behind the league leader chasing the 35th championship title.

items.raw_excerpt: Det er ikke luksusvilla og badebasseng som frister forskerne.
items.summary_en: A 900-year-old church in Norway is being prepared as an observation spot for the upcoming solar eclipse. Researchers say the historic building offers perfect conditions for watching the celestial event. The ancient church will soon feel like a space station for astronomers.
items.summary_ko: 개기일식을 앞두고 노르웨이의 900년 된 교회가 관측 장소로 준비되고 있다. 연구자들은 이 역사적인 건물이 천문 현상을 관찰하기에 완벽한 조건을 갖추고 있다고 말한다. 곧 고대 교회가 천문학자들의 우주 정거장처럼 변할 예정이다.

items.summary_en: A pensioner in frail health was left distressed and out of pocket after both his Winter Energy Payment and Disability Allowance were stopped due to government mistakes. The errors left him without crucial financial support during winter.

items.summary_en: Porto's metropolitan transport authority launched the 'Validate Your Pass' campaign. The campaign promotes free Youth Passes for people under 23 years old, whether or not they are students.
